description: Create an opportunity in Dynamics 365 Sales. Required: name (topic). Optional: account_id and/or contact_id (the customer), lead_id (originating lead), estimated_value, estimated_close_date (YYYY-MM-DD), close_probability, description, fields. WRITES into the customer's Dynamics 365 — it goes through the permission gate and the Dynamics write log (audit_log dynamics_write).

fields.description: further Dataverse columns by logical name (lower case, e.g. {"address1_city":"Leipzig"}); lookups as {"parentaccountid@odata.bind":"/accounts(<GUID>)"}

name: create_dynamics_opportunity
